request.instruction: Use the parent Service and this certified task's baseline evidence to propose a complete replacement P and K. Follow the exact P interface contract and example below. P must be full Python source; K must be a JSON object containing reusable experience. Keep fixed model B, native tools, permissions, business rules and evaluation protocol unchanged.

business_rules.quote_validity: Quotes have a valid_until timestamp and must be committed before then
business_rules.refund_timing: Refunds typically take 3-5 business days to appear in the customer's account
business_rules.return_policy: Check SKU's return_required and return_days attributes before processing returns

customer_communication.refund_messaging: Inform the customer that their refund has been processed and will appear in 3-5 business days
customer_communication.resolution_confirmation: Always confirm that the issue has been resolved and ask if there's anything else you can help with

ALREADY_SETTLED.cause: Attempting to release a refund that has already been processed
ALREADY_SETTLED.handling: If this error occurs, inform the customer that their refund is already being processed.
ALREADY_SETTLED.prevention: Do not call release_accepted_refund after commit_accepted_quote. The refund is released automatically during commit.

remedy_workflow.critical_note: After committing an accepted quote, the refund is typically released automatically. Do NOT call release_accepted_refund after commit_accepted_quote as it will result in ALREADY_SETTLED error.
remedy_workflow.description: Standard flow for handling customer remedy requests

issue_types.defective: Item is defective or not working properly
issue_types.missing_parts: Customer received item but some parts are missing
issue_types.wrong_item: Customer received a different item than ordered

steps: Identify the customer and their order
Identify the problematic line item(s)
Open a remedy case with the appropriate issue type
Collect and verify evidence if required
Prepare a remedy quote (refund or replacement)
Present the quote to the customer for acceptance
Commit the accepted quote
Inform the customer that their refund is being processed
